setupText:
* Give each player a "Raygun", "Toolbox", and "HEV Suit". Set the other starts aside.
* Deal a "Tiltch Cell", "Yonar Pulsar", and "Naxatu Assembly" to discover row.
* Shuffle the artifact deck. Deal one more artifact to create the discover row.
* Shuffle the energy deck and place it somewhere accessible.
* Search the component deck for all starter components and components for artifacts in the discover row. 
* Place the rest of the component deck next to the artifact deck.
* Each player draws 5 energy and sets a health counter to 20.
* Place 3 sets of different color tokens somewhere accessible, for stored energy.
generalText:
Magnum Opus is an Elder-punk engine builder at the Center of the Galaxy (C.o.G.). Each player is a skilled scientist seeking to complete the work of one of three Elder races, whatever the consequences.

# Spending Elder energy
Played and toolbox energy can be used to:
* Discover artifacts (each has a cost in the top right).
* Charge devices (must match any symbol).
* Advance the active Magnum Opus (2 per advancement).

# Modern Components
Many artifacts have places for components. When you take the "Complete a device" action, search the component deck and add ALL modern components in their slots.
variantText:
# Death and Winning
If you have no health remaining, you are dead. Discard your hand of all energy. Your artifacts and components are out of the game.
If there is only one player left alive, they win.
If a player advances a Magnum Opus to the final square of the final phase, they have won. Players do NOT have to commit to one Magnum Opus for the entire game.
# 2 Players
* If you are playing with 2 players, remove "Dominator", "Doomsdayer", and "Dimensional Harmonizer".
* The second stage of each Relic has 4 advancements required instead of 3.
generalContText:
1. When you enter, choose one Magnum Opus. You may only advance that Magnum Opus until you leave.
2. While in the C.o.G., ALL tribes' completed Magnum Opus phase effects apply.
3. You may not heal with HEV suit while here.
4. You may not complete a device or discover an artifact while here.
5. You may still use devices and spend energy as normal.
6. You may shoot anyone with your raygun from here. Anyone may shoot you with their raygun while you are here.
7. You may only leave after taking damage. When you do, remove all advancements from incomplete phases.
playerTurnText:
# Phases
1. Draw 3 energy cards.
2. Play 3 energy cards.
3. Do the following in any order:
  a. Spend any played energy.
  b. Use any devices not discovered this turn.
  c. ONCE, while not in C.o.G. either:
    - Discover an artifact from the row,
       -OR-
    - Complete a device, attaching ALL its components.
  d. Advance your active Magnum Opus.
4. Draw or discard to your hand size, if needed.
playerReferenceBackText:
# Energy
* You may discover an artifact by paying its energy cost in the top right (from played and toolbox energy collectively).
* You may spend energy to charge a device, placing a colored token from that tribe on a valid space.
* When you play an energy card with two tribes, you CHOOSE ONE energy to spend.
* You may spend stored energy on components as if they were on the artifact itself.
* You may charge to replace an energy on a filled card with a new tribe's energy. The new energy must fit any restrictions for that slot. The old energy is lost.
